gloss: in the middle of work; working; under construction

definitions.gloss: in the middle of work; working; under construction
definitions.explanation: Indicates that work or an operation is currently in progress. Used on signs, in status messages, and in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ただいま{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}です。
{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}につき{通行止|つうこうど}め。
examples.english: Road closed due to work in progress.

examples.japanese: サーバーは{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}のため、しばらくお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: The server is undergoing maintenance, so please wait a moment.

notes:
A compound of {作業|さぎょう} ('work, operation, task') and {中|ちゅう} ('during, in the middle of'). Very commonly seen on signs at construction sites, in software status messages, and as a general way to say something is in progress. The suffix {中|ちゅう} can attach to many nouns to indicate an ongoing state.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作業中|さぎょうちゅう}につき: due to work in progress
- {作業中|さぎょうちゅう}{注意|ちゅうい}: caution: work in progress
- ただいま{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}: currently working

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {工事中|こうじちゅう}: under construction — specifically for building/road construction
- メンテナンス{中|ちゅう}: under maintenance — common for websites and systems
- {準備中|じゅんびちゅう}: in preparation — for shops or events not yet open
